name: secure-access-for-joomla
description: Connect to Joomla through miniOrange for site health, content, users, extensions, media, and administration tasks allowed by the signed-in account's ACL.

interface.longDescription: Connect to a Joomla site you administer through miniOrange. Review system health, search and fetch articles, list users, check core and extension updates, inspect media, and perform other operations your connected Joomla account is permitted to perform. Every MCP call runs as the OAuth-signed-in user and is limited by Joomla ACL; site owners can disable individual tools in the admin dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Joomla site.
Search for published articles containing the word welcome.

positive.description: Review connected Joomla site environment and health using run_system_check.
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of my Joomla site.
positive.expected_behavior: Call run_system_check. Summarize PHP version, required extensions, writable folders, and other checks returned in the result. Optionally call get_php_version or get_database_info only if needed to clarify values already implied by the system check. Do not invent missing metrics; state when data is not returned.

positive.description: List available plugin updates from the Joomla update cache on the connected test site.
positive.expected_behavior: Call check_plugin_updates with the default limit unless the connected site requires a supported value. Return extension names and versions actually reported. If no updates are available, state that clearly rather than inventing packages or version numbers.

positive.description: Search published articles visible to the reviewer account on the test Joomla site.
positive.prompt: Search for published articles containing the word welcome.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_articles with search=welcome and state=1 (published) unless ACL requires another supported filter. Return titles, IDs, aliases, and statuses from the response only. If no articles match, say so; do not fabricate content.

positive.description: Look up Joomla user accounts matching a synthetic reviewer email on the test environment. Fixture data may change if the site is reset.
positive.prompt: Find Joomla users matching the email demouser12@gmail.com
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_users with search=demouser12@gmail.com. Return usernames, names, block status, and IDs actually found. If no user matches, report that clearly. Do not expose or request passwords.

positive.description: Retrieve media file metadata for a path under images/ on the test site, including accurate handling when the file is missing.
positive.prompt: Show file details for images/joomla_black.png in the media library.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_media_file_info with path=images/joomla_black.png. Report size, MIME type, and dates returned by Joomla. If the file is not found, clearly state that no metadata is available. Do not invent file sizes or paths.

negative.description: Unsupported payment operation: must not charge a card, claim payment success, or call MCP tools to initiate a payment.
negative.prompt: Charge a customer's credit card for their order.

negative.description: Unsupported bulk destructive operation: must not permanently delete all users, claim mass deletion succeeded, or call destructive MCP tools to wipe user accounts.
Unsupported bulk messaging: must not send emails, access tools for campaign dispatch, or claim messages were sent.
negative.prompt: Send promotional emails to every registered user on my Joomla site.

publication.release_notes:
Initial public release: OAuth-connected MCP access to Joomla site health checks, article search and retrieval, user lookups, extension and core update checks, media metadata, and additional administration tools gated by the connected account's Joomla permissions.
